newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt lowers Amriyah stake to 48 pct.
newsitem.headline: Egypt lowers Amriyah stake to 48 pct.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Holding Company for Metallurgical Industries said on Thursday it completed the sale of 3.4 million shares in Amriyah Cement, reducing its stake to about 48 percent.
The sale represented about 17 percent of the equity.
Private investors and funds had owned 34.6 percent of Amriyah and the holding company 65.4 percent.
The statement published in al-Akhbar newspaper said the sale, part of the Egyptian government's privatisation programme, reduced the state stake to 48.36 percent.
The state had sold the shares in two stages on the Cairo stock exchange. On Thursday Amriyah shares closed up 2.50 pounds at 65.50.
